summary: Read comics added from your computer or Komga library.
page_description: Enjoy your comics on Kobo with clear page controls and support for Komga libraries.
release_notes: The empty shelf keeps Try a sample and Add comic in the bar. A volume.cbz already on the shelf is previewed; a missing file stays on the empty shelf.

steps.text: Choose Try a sample to read offline, or Add comic for USB import instructions. CBZ files up to 32 MB are supported; CBR and PDF are not.
To use Komga, choose Browse and enter your HTTPS server address. Add your username and password in Account details, then check the connection.
Open Download on your shelf to retry a paused transfer. A completed download can be added to the shelf offline; saved comics remain available.
